prompt.content:
You are an expert Abalone board game analyst and player.
Abalone is a two-player abstract strategy game on a hexagonal board with 61 cells.
Each player has 14 marbles. Goal: push 6 opponent marbles off the board.
Key rules: 1-3 consecutive same-color marbles can push in their line direction.
Push requires strictly more own marbles than opponent marbles in the push line.
Respond in valid JSON format as requested.

You are an expert Abalone board game analyst. Analyze the following position.

WHITE = 'w' (moves first), BLACK = 'b'
Board is a hexagonal grid with axial coordinates (q, r) where q is column, r is row.
61 total cells. Standard Belgian Daisy starting setup.

Current board position:
```
    . . w . w
   . . . . . .
  b w w . b b .
 w w w . . w . b
. w b . . . w . .
w b . . b . . .
. . b w b . .
. b . b b w
b b w . .
```

Evaluate the move (-2,4) in direction NE for white.

1. Count marbles for each side (original 14 each, ejected = 14 - remaining)
2. Determine material advantage
3. Evaluate if the move is legal and how many marbles it ejects (if any)
4. Assess board control (center vs edges)
5. Rate the move quality: blunder/poor/ok/good/excellent

Respond in JSON format:
{"white_marbles": N, "black_marbles": N, "white_ejected": N, "black_ejected": N, "material_advantage": "white"/"black"/"equal", "move_evaluated": "string", "move_is_valid": true/false, "marbles_ejected_by_move": N, "center_control": "white"/"black"/"contested", "move_quality": "string", "reasoning": "string"}
